In this masterclass you recognise shikhara and vimana developments across regions.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Elevation reading
  • Regional variations
  • Reconstruction cautions

How the time is spent

  1. Elevation reading 30 min

    Base mouldings, walls, towers, finials.

    You: annotate elevation

  2. Regional variations 60 min

    Nagara Latina/Shekhari vs Dravida storeys.

    You: comparative silhouettes

  3. Reconstruction cautions 30 min

    Do not complete missing parts without evidence.

    You: reasoned caption

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.
